description: Create a Solana Pay quote to top up this API key with USDC on Solana mainnet. Returns transaction_url, solana_pay_url, amount_usdc and a reference. POST {"account": "<your wallet address>"} to transaction_url to get a ready-to-sign base64 transaction; sign and send it. Or show solana_pay_url as a QR code for a human to scan in Phantom. Then call check_usdc_payment. No browser needed.

api_key.description: Your ogfetch API key (ogf_...). Optional if the MCP connection is already configured with an Authorization header.

name: buy_credits_usdc
title: Buy credits with USDC (Solana Pay)
